gpu_before.note: Active event intervals grouped by GPU channel. Channels and nested intervals can overlap; these totals are not frame wall time. Profiled capture is not an uninstrumented FPS run.

gpu_resources_before.note: Metal resource creation turnover, not resident memory or general CPU malloc counts. Texture-view events may have zero bytes. Window edges can include partial frames.

drawable_waits_before.note: Waiting for a drawable; scheduling, VSync and backpressure can contribute. Not a GPU pass duration.

note: Single sequential diagnostic cases, not confidence intervals. Different frame-dependent trajectories before the timing fix. GPU channel intervals overlap and are not additive; allocation bytes are resource turnover, not resident memory.
